test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Have you decided what you want to become when you grown up.
solution: The correct answer is** 'when you grown up'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'when you grow up'** should be used instead of **'when you grown up'**. • In the given sentence the past participle of '**grow**' that is '**grown**' is wrongly used. • We use the **present simple** for something scheduled/ planned future. • *Example: The train **arrives **at 6.30 in the morning.* • *​*Also, as it is an interrogative sentence, a question mark (?) should be used at the end of the sentence. **Correct Sentence:__** *Have you decided what you want to become **when you grow up?.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ, **'when you grown up'** के स्थान पर **'when you grow up' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में '**grown**' यानी '**grow**' के** past participle **का गलत इस्तेमाल किया गया है। • हम **Simple Present tense **का उपयोग कुछ निर्धारित / नियोजित भविष्य के लिए करते हैं। • *Example: The train **arrives **at 6.30 in the morning.* 45:Tc77, The correct answer is '**is**'.
